summary: DevNet HydrantID chain is not trusted by system or bundled CA
recommendation: Obtain the approved issuing chain for each deployment and configure VMANAGE_CA_BUNDLE; never normalize verify=false
acceptance_criterion: Live smoke test passes with VMANAGE_VERIFY_SSL=true

summary: No production-like load or soak environment was available
recommendation: Run 1/10/25 concurrent read calls and a 30-60 minute soak under an approved request ceiling
acceptance_criterion: p95/error/auth/retry/resource budgets are agreed and pass

summary: Correlation thresholds and device-type assumptions lack formal SME sign-off
recommendation: Review controller classification, >50% site scope, BFD/control missing values, CPU/memory thresholds, and alarm casing against supported releases
acceptance_criterion: Signed truth table and golden fixtures cover each supported vManage version

summary: Interactive app/provider adapters lacked a dedicated coverage gate
recommendation: Added mocked Claude/OpenAI/Gemini tool cycles plus console boot/shell/renderer lifecycle tests
acceptance_criterion: app.py and ai_providers.py each reached 80% branch coverage

summary: CLI and installer line coverage was below target
recommendation: Added Click CliRunner tests and platform-path/merge/error installer tests
acceptance_criterion: CLI reached 60% and installer reached 86% branch coverage

summary: Event device filtering downloaded the endpoint's full result set before local filtering
recommendation: Implemented verified GET query rules for entry_time and system_ip, retaining local filtering as defense in depth
acceptance_criterion: Server-filtered live event call passes with normalized output fields

summary: Pydantic helpers were undocumented and untested outside flat FastMCP signatures
recommendation: Exported and documented them as optional public validation helpers with schema and boundary tests
acceptance_criterion: Model package is a documented API with 100% coverage

summary: Cisco IDE SDK auto-collects hostname, IP, and MAC when enabled
recommendation: Obtain privacy approval and document retention/access controls before deployment enables it
acceptance_criterion: Approved data-flow record references SDK payload and destination

summary: Splunk telemetry uses daemon threads and may lose events at shutdown
recommendation: Retain best-effort semantics or add a bounded flush queue if delivery becomes a requirement
acceptance_criterion: Telemetry documentation continues to state best-effort behavior

summary: Manifest was not validated against an authenticated Cisco marketplace schema
recommendation: Run the marketplace publisher/schema validator in an authenticated Cisco IDE session
